Sign in under Supabase to save vehicles across browsers. Without sign-in, entries stay in this browser. Do not enter the IoT SIM number here.

Add device & vehicle

Add any model and its unique device ID (6–64 letters, numbers, _ - :). IMEI-only registration is also allowed. GPS requires a compatible protocol adapter and an online receiver.

ZEWAY IoT cloud account

Sign in to save devices across browsers and see GPS positions when an integrated device receiver sends them.

Only your signed-in account can read its vehicles and positions. A device stays Offline until a real GPS update arrives. Keep the receiver secret on its server.

Data connection

Connect an HTTPS receiver for any supported device protocol. The Supabase account also receives GPS from an integrated receiver.

Checks every 10 seconds. Token is kept only for this browser tab. The receiver must allow this dashboard's origin through CORS. A private dashboard URL does not receive raw device TCP packets; those go to the receiver.
